title: Onfolio Holdings, Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Onfolio Holdings Inc., a small-cap emerging growth company listed on Nasdaq Capital Market, entered into an Equity Purchase Facility Agreement allowing the company to sell up to $100 million of new common stock to a single institutional investor over 24 months. The company will allocate 25% of proceeds to cryptocurrency acquisitions as reserve assets and 75% to working capital and general corporate purposes.
key_points: Onfolio Holdings Inc. (ONFO) entered into an Equity Purchase Facility Agreement with an institutional investor on April 10, 2026
The facility allows the company to sell up to $100 million in newly issued common stock over 24 months at its discretion
25% of proceeds are designated for cryptocurrency reserve assets; 75% for working capital and general corporate purposes
A commitment fee of 50,000 shares (the 'Commitment Shares') was paid to the investor
Issuances are limited to 19.99% of outstanding shares unless stockholder approval is obtained, per Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(d)
A 9.99% beneficial ownership cap applies to the investor at any time
